attacks.claim: The QA table reports staff pilot results (0 misdelivered texts, 2 copy fixes shipped and re-verified), but the rollout schedules that pilot for Nov 2-6. Today is 2026-10-26, so the pilot has not run. A load-bearing pass claim, and the real-world evidence the 09:00 all-cardholder flip rests on, is unsupported.
attacks.evidence: "Staff pilot week (64 staff cards, real holds) | 0 misdelivered texts; 2 copy fixes shipped and re-verified" vs "1. Nov 2-6: flags on for staff cards only (pilot above)."

attacks.claim: The fixed announcement says text alerts are "for every cardholder". The feature is opt-in, and juvenile cards never see the option (guardians must opt in on their own account). The line overstates availability and omits the opt-in step.
attacks.evidence: "Text alerts for holds, for every cardholder." vs "juvenile cards do not show it"

attacks.claim: The locker's accessibility features (high-contrast mode, audio guidance, adjustable text size) have no QA row. Only the opt-in web form was screen-reader tested. Vendor and staff acceptance testing is mentioned but does not cover these features.
attacks.evidence: "screen has high-contrast mode, audio guidance through a headphone jack, and adjustable text size" vs QA row "Opt-in form with NVDA + Firefox, VoiceOver iOS"

attacks.claim: The sms_holds flag-off rollback and the alert paging are not exercised in QA. Only the spend-cap fallback is tested, and it shares the same fallback path.
attacks.evidence: QA row "Spend cap reached (test cap $5) → fallback to email / phone call | Pass"; no flag-off or alert-fire test

attacks.claim: The 38k texts/month forecast has no stated derivation, and the $900 hard cap is roughly twice the $460 funded amount. Phone-call fallback cost is not budgeted. The cap does bound SMS spend.
attacks.evidence: "Forecast 38,000 texts/month at about $0.012 all-in = ~$460/month" / "hard spend cap $900/month"

attacks.claim: The locker rollback does not say how outstanding single-use codes are invalidated or how items already in cells are handled beyond staff moving them.
attacks.evidence: "remapped to the branch desk by `scripts/remap_locker_holds.sql` ... staff move items to the holds shelf"
